retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
DNS TUNNELING

DESCRIPTION:
DNS tunneling uses DNS traffic to bypass network controls and transfer data or establish command-and-control communication.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1071.004 | DNS

INDICATORS:
- Excessive DNS queries
- Long encoded domain names
- Unusual DNS traffic volume
- Connections to suspicious domains

DETECTION RULES:
- High-entropy DNS queries
- Excessive DNS requests

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Endpoints
- DNS servers
title: DNS TUNNELING
